bio.text: John Payton was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 22, which includes Independence and Sharp counties and parts of several others.
He served in the Arkansas House from 2013 through 2022 and was House Majority Party Whip in 2017 and 2019.
He attended Missouri Auction School, owns two auto auctions and two used auto dealerships, and raises cattle on his family farm in Wilburn.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JOHN PAYTON
